title: Odd Jobs
description: The summer job situation looks bleak for five college pals until they decide to start their own moving business.

title: Pacific Rim Uprising
description: Jake Pentecost, son of Stacker Pentecost, reunites with Mako Mori to lead a new generation of Jaeger pilots, including rival Lambert and 15-year-old hacker Amara, against a new Kaiju threat.

title: Man Down
description: With help from his best friend (Jai Courtney), a Marine (Shia LaBeouf) embarks on a desperate search to find his wife (Kate Mara) and son (Charlie Shotwell) in post-apocalyptic America.

title: Our Kind of Traitor
description: A money launderer (Stellan Skarsgard) for Russian gangsters asks a couple vacationing in Marrakech, Morocco, to deliver incriminating evidence to an MI6 agent (Damian Lewis).

title: The Greatest Showman
description: P.T. Barnum indulges his limitless imagination to create the Barnum & Bailey circus in the 1800s. Featuring musical numbers, exotic performers and daring feats, the mesmerizing spectacle takes the world by storm to become the greatest show on Earth.

title: Pitch Perfect 3
description: After the highs of winning the world championships, the Bellas find themselves split apart. But when they get the chance to reunite for an overseas USO tour, the group of nerds comes together to make some music one last time.

title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
description: In 1770 the young daughter of a French countess develops a mutual attraction to the female artist commissioned to paint her wedding portrait.

title: The Blair Witch Project
description: A filmmaking crew (Heather Donahue, Michael C. Williams, Joshua Leonard) hikes into Maryland's Black Hills Forest seeking clues about a legendary witch.

title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
description: When a townie takes collegians on an overnight tour in Burkittsville, Md., they awake to chaos and have no memory of sleeping.

title: Blair Witch
description: A group of friends (James Allen McCune, Callie Hernandez, Corbin Reid) and their two guides encounter the legendary Blair Witch while exploring the Black Hills Forest in Maryland.

title: Happy Death Day
description: A college student must relive the day of her murder over and over again, in a loop that will end only when she discovers her killer's identity.

title: Scanners
description: A scientist (Patrick McGoohan) sends a "scanner" (Stephen Lack) to hunt others like him with explosive psychic powers.

title: A Streetcar Named Desire
description: Tennessee Williams' Blanche DuBois (Vivien Leigh) moves in with her sister, Stella (Kim Hunter), and brutish brother-in-law, Stanley Kowalski (Marlon Brando).

title: Walk the Line
description: Johnny Cash (Joaquin Phoenix) forms an enduring bond with June Carter (Reese Witherspoon) and struggles with drug addiction on the way to music stardom.

title: Once Were Brothers: Robbie Robertson and The Band
description: The story of a band that went from backing up Bob Dylan to becoming one of the most influential groups of its era.

title: The Shape of Water
description: Elisa is a mute, isolated woman who works in a hidden, high-security government laboratory. Her life changes forever when she discovers the lab's classified secret -- a mysterious, scaled creature from South America that lives in a water tank.

title: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
description: A fatherless teen starts to insinuate himself into the life of a renowned surgeon, his wife and two children. The full scope of his intent soon becomes menacingly clear when he confronts the doctor with a long-forgotten transgression.

title: The Lobster
description: In a dystopian society, single people must find a mate within 45 days or be transformed into an animal of their choice.

title: Opus
description: A journalist is invited to the remote compound of a legendary pop star who mysteriously disappeared 30 years ago. Surrounded by the star's cult of sycophants, she gets caught in the middle of his twisted plan.

title: Joker
description: Isolated, bullied and disregarded by society, failed comedian Arthur Fleck begins a slow descent into madness as he transforms into the criminal mastermind known as the Joker.

title: Joker: Folie à Deux
description: Struggling with his dual identity, failed comedian Arthur Fleck stumbles upon true love while incarcerated at Arkham State Hospital. Awaiting trial for the murder of five people, Fleck soon discovers the music that's always been inside him.

title: Birds of Prey (and the Fantabulous Emancipation of One Harley Quinn)
description: Harley Quinn faces the wrath of narcissistic crime boss Black Mask and every other thug in Gotham. But things soon even out for Harley when she becomes unexpected allies with three deadly women -- Huntress, Black Canary and Renee Montoya.

title: My Soul to Take
description: A teen (Max Thieriot) must figure a way to save his friends from a presumed-dead serial killer who has returned to finish the job he started 16 years earlier.

title: Catfish
description: An unexpected odyssey rolls out when a filmmaker's brother begins receiving unusually advanced paintings from a girl, supposedly 8 years old.

title: Men
description: Harper retreats to the countryside to be alone in the wake of a tragedy, but her unease at the town's leering and uncannily similar men grows into a fully fledged nightmare as her arrival awakens something primal in the forest.

title: Despicable Me
description: As he tries to execute a fiendish plot to steal the moon, a supervillain meets his match in three little orphan girls who want to make him their dad.

title: Space Jam
description: In a desperate attempt to win a basketball match and earn their freedom, the Looney Tunes seek the aid of retired basketball champion, Michael Jordan.

title: Space Jam: A New Legacy
description: Trapped in digital space by a rogue AI, superstar LeBron James teams up with Bugs Bunny and the rest of the Looney Tunes gang for a high-stakes basketball game against digitized champions of the court -- a powered-up roster called the Goon Squad.

title: Monster-in-Law
description: A woman fights back when her fiancé's shrewish mother tries to destroy their relationship.

title: Ocean's 11
description: Veterans of the 82nd Airborne Division devise an elaborate plot to simultaneously rob five casinos on New Year's Eve.

title: Mickey 17
description: A disposable employee is sent on a human expedition to colonize the ice world Niflheim. After one iteration dies, a new body is regenerated with most of his memories intact.

title: Kingsman: The Golden Circle
description: With their headquarters destroyed and the world held hostage, members of Kingsman join forces with their American counterparts to battle a ruthless and common enemy.

title: Ocean's Eight
description: Debbie Ocean assembles an all-female team of thieves and specialists for a heist during the Met Gala, aiming for the $150 million worth of diamonds around the neck of world-famous actress Daphne Kluger.

title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
description: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race.

title: The Nun II
description: An evil spreads in 1956 France as a priest is murdered, and Sister Irene once again comes face-to-face with the demonic nun Valak.

title: The Watchers
description: A 28-year-old artist gets stranded in an expansive, untouched forest in western Ireland. Finding shelter, she unknowingly becomes trapped alongside three strangers who are stalked by mysterious creatures every night.

title: Companion
description: A weekend getaway at a remote cabin turns to chaos when it's revealed that one of the guests -- a subservient android built for human companionship -- has gone haywire.

title: Holla
description: A mysterious killer stalks a sitcom actress (Shelli Boone) and her companions (Young Sir, Michael Bergin) on a weekend getaway in the wilderness.

title: Hop
description: Reluctant to take over his father's job, the son (Russell Brand) of the Easter Bunny runs away to Los Angeles, where he tricks an unemployed slacker (James Marsden) into taking care of him.

title: The Biggest Little Farm
description: A couple are followed through their successes and failures as they work to develop a sustainable farm on 200 acres outside of Los Angeles.

title: The Last Emperor
description: Named Emperor of China at age 3 in 1908, Pu Yi (John Lone) becomes a prisoner of destiny.

title: Meg 2: The Trench
description: Jonas Taylor leads a research team on an exploratory dive into the deepest depths of the ocean. Pitted against colossal, prehistoric sharks and relentless environmental plunderers, they must outrun, outsmart and outswim their merciless predators.

title: Open Water
description: Scuba divers (Blanchard Ryan, Daniel Travis) struggle to survive in shark-infested waters after their tour boat accidentally leaves them behind.

title: The Apparition
description: A paranormal researcher (Tom Felton) must save a couple (Ashley Greene, Sebastian Stan) from a malevolent entity that feeds on fear and torments them no matter where they run.

title: The Possession
description: Parents (Jeffrey Dean Morgan, Kyra Sedgwick) must work together to save their young daughter (Natasha Calis) from a dybbuk, a malevolent spirit that inhabits and ultimately devours its human host.

title: Carrie
description: A social misfit (Sissy Spacek) with psychic powers wreaks havoc at her prom to get even with pranksters.

title: Halloween: The Curse of Michael Myers
description: An ancient Celtic ritual drives Dr. Loomis' (Donald Pleasence) patient to sacrifice an entire family in Haddonfield, Ill.

title: Halloween H20: 20 Years Later
description: In hiding for two decades, a traumatized woman (Jamie Lee Curtis) learns her murderous brother has returned for her.
